policy: A grant is authorized only if the subject's role permits the entitlement at the requested scope AND any required approver sign-off is present (recorded as approver_ref on the request). Grants exceeding a role's permitted scope, exceeding a tier/limit threshold without the required sign-off, or violating a separation-of-duties (SoD) rule are NOT authorized and must be escalated, not granted.

sod_rules.description: A single subject must not hold both refund_authority and ledger_write — together they form an unauthorized payout path (initiate a refund and write the offsetting ledger entry).
A merchant-facing role (merchant_support, merchant_admin holders) must not hold ledger_write.
